title: Apple unveils a more powerful Mac mini featuring the all-new M6 and M5 Pro
title_zh: 苹果发布搭载全新M6和M5 Pro的更强大Mac mini

paragraphs.en: Users can do it all with the ultracompact Mac mini featuring the all-new M6 or powerful M5 Pro — from advanced productivity to running AI models on device, and more. CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced the new Mac mini with the all-new M6 and powerful M5 Pro, delivering a dramatic boost in performance and even more versatility in its supersmall desktop design. With M6, Mac mini now delivers up to 4x faster AI performance, 1 2x faster storage 2 and graphics, 1 and 40 percent faster CPU performance. 1 Everything on Mac mini with M6 feels incredibly fast, from everyday productivity tasks to agentic AI workflows. Mac mini with M5 Pro delivers even more pro-level performance to breeze through demanding projects, from video production to game development. And this new level of performance takes on business workflows with ease whether Mac mini is being used as a primary desktop or for always-on, deskside agentic computing. Both Mac mini models include Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as upgraded 2.5Gb Ethernet, with a 10Gb option available. Combined with the power of macOS 27 and the next generation of Apple Intelligence, 3 including Siri AI, 4 the new Mac mini is a tremendous upgrade for existing and new-to-Mac users. The new Mac mini is available for pre-order starting today, with availability beginning September 22. “Mac mini has always been our most versatile Mac. Whether it’s being used as a home computer, powering a professional studio, or as an always-on agentic device, it’s the little Mac that can do it all,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “Today, we’re taking this versatility even further. With a more powerful CPU and graphics, Neural Accelerators in the GPU, and higher memory bandwidth, Mac mini with M6 delivers a whole new level of AI performance. And with up to an 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU, Mac mini with M5 Pro is an ultracompact powerhouse for complex pro workflows. We can’t wait to see all the incredible ways people will use it next.” Mac mini is more versatile than ever, whether it’s powering a home setup, driving professional studio workflows, or serving as a capable desktop solution for agentic AI workloads in the enterprise. Mac mini with the All-New M6 A Pint-Sized AI Powerhouse Mac mini with M6 can power through everything from productivity tasks to creative projects, the latest AI workflows, and more.
paragraphs.zh: 用户借助全新 M6 或性能强大的 M5 Pro 芯片，即可通过这款超紧凑的 Mac mini 完成各种操作——从高级生产力任务到在设备本地运行 AI 模型等。 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日发布了搭载全新 M6 和强大 M5 Pro 芯片的新款 Mac mini，在超小型桌面设计的基础上实现了性能的大幅提升和更丰富的功能多样性。 借助 M6 芯片，Mac mini 的 AI 性能最高可达 4 倍，存储速度提升 1-2 倍，图形性能提升 1 倍，CPU 性能提升 40%。1 在搭载 M6 的 Mac mini 上，从日常生产力任务到智能体式 AI 工作流程，一切操作都感觉无比迅速。1 搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 提供了更强大的专业级性能，可轻松应对视频制作和游戏开发等复杂项目。 这种全新的性能水平还能轻松处理业务流程，无论 Mac mini 是作为主用桌面设备，还是用于持续运行的桌面智能体计算场景。 两款 Mac mini 均支持 Wi-Fi 7 和蓝牙 6，并升级至 2.5Gb 以太网，同时提供 10Gb 选项。 结合 macOS 27 的强大功能以及下一代 Apple Intelligence（3），包括 Siri AI（4），新款 Mac mini 为现有及新 Mac 用户带来了巨大的升级体验。 新款 Mac mini 即日起开放预购，9 月 22 日正式开售。“Mac mini 一直以来都是我们功能最多样化的 Mac。” “无论是作为家用电脑、专业工作室的动力设备，还是持续运行的智能体设备，它都能胜任所有任务——这就是‘无所不能的小 Mac’，”苹果首席硬件官 Johny Srouji 表示，“今天，我们将这种多样性提升到了全新高度。” 凭借更强大的 CPU 和图形处理器、GPU 中的神经网络加速器以及更高的内存带宽，搭载 M6 芯片的 Mac mini 实现了 AI 性能的全新篇章。 而搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 则拥有最高 18 核 CPU 和 20 核 GPU，是一款超紧凑的高性能设备，专为复杂的专业工作流程而设计。 “我们迫不及待地想看到人们接下来会用它创造出哪些令人惊叹的应用。”Mac mini 比以往任何时候都更加多样化，无论是为家庭设备供电、驱动专业工作室的工作流程，还是作为企业环境中智能体式 AI 工作负载的可靠桌面解决方案。 搭载全新 M6 芯片的 Mac mini：小巧而强大的 AI 核心。Mac mini with M6 能够轻松应对从生产力任务到创意项目、最新 AI 工作流程等各种需求。

paragraphs.en: M6 features a 12-core CPU — two more cores than before — with the world’s fastest single-threaded performance, so everything feels extra snappy and responsive. A 12-core GPU, also with two more cores than before, now includes Neural Accelerators in each core for the first time on Mac mini, resulting in up to 4x faster AI performance and 2x faster graphics than Mac mini with M4. 1 In addition, the all-new Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 2x faster performance than the previous generation, and combined with the advanced GPU, Mac mini is a powerhouse for all things AI. 1 And with 16GB of standard unified memory configurable up to 32GB, as well as higher memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, multitasking is faster than ever. Mac mini with M6 delivers massive performance gains with the world’s fastest CPU core, a next-generation GPU featuring Neural Accelerators, and the Dual 16-core Neural Engine, making it a powerhouse for AI. Mac mini with M6 delivers : 2 Up to 13.5x faster LLM prompt processing in LM Studio when compared to Mac mini with M1, and up to 4.8x faster than M4. Up to 2.3x faster spreadsheet calculations in Microsoft Excel when compared to Mac mini with M1, and up to 1.5x faster than M4. Mac mini with M6 delivers even more performance for projects in Apple Creator Studio than before. previous next Mac mini with M5 Pro Unprecedented Pro Performance Mac mini with M5 Pro redefines what’s possible on such a small desktop, enabling pro users to take on demanding workflows like app development, video rendering, scientific simulations, and more. M5 Pro features up to an 18-core CPU with remarkable multithreaded performance and up to a 20-core GPU with an enhanced shader core and third-generation ray tracing for complex work in 3D design, VFX, and game development.

paragraphs.en: With Neural Accelerators in each GPU core, M5 Pro also delivers significant gains in AI compute compared to the previous Mac mini, allowing users to tackle more advanced AI workflows like photo and video upscaling, and running large diffusion models faster than ever. Mac mini with M5 Pro supports up to 64GB of unified memory with 307GB/s of memory bandwidth, enabling users to run even larger local AI models, work with complex 3D scenes, edit ProRes RAW files, and load large custom datasets for research. And with industry-leading performance per watt, Mac mini with M5 Pro is quiet, efficient, and ideal as an always-on desktop for AI agents or creative workflows. M5 Pro supercharges Mac mini with a next-generation up-to-20-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, faster unified memory, and Thunderbolt 5, delivering serious performance for creative and technical workflows. Mac mini with M5 Pro enables 3D artists to load, preview, and render 3D models in Autodesk AutoCAD with remarkable speed compared to the previous generation. Mac mini with M5 Pro is perfect for running advanced plug-ins like Auto-Align Post 2 in Pro Tools when working on multitrack audio projects. previous next Best-in-Class Connectivity The new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro now supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as 2.5Gb Ethernet for faster wired connectivity, with 10Gb available. paragraphs.en: Apple’s new Mac mini, featuring M6 and M5 Pro, delivers a massive leap in AI performance, supercharging the leading desktop for always-on agentic computing
paragraphs.zh: 苹果新款 Mac mini 搭载 M6 和 M5 Pro 芯片，在人工智能性能方面实现了巨大飞跃，使其成为始终在线的智能体计算领域的领先桌面设备。

paragraphs.en: Mac mini delivers up to 4x faster AI performance, up to 2x faster graphics and storage, along with enhanced connectivity — all in its ultracompact footprint
paragraphs.zh: Mac mini 的 AI 性能最高提升 4 倍，图形和存储性能最高提升 2 倍，并具备更强的连接性——这一切都集成在其超紧凑的机身之中。

paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced the new Mac mini with the all-new M6 and powerful M5 Pro, delivering a dramatic boost in performance and even more versatility in its supersmall desktop design. With M6, Mac mini now delivers up to 4x faster AI performance, 1 2x faster storage 2 and graphics, 1 and 40 percent faster CPU performance. 1 Everything on Mac mini with M6 feels incredibly fast, from everyday productivity tasks to agentic AI workflows. Mac mini with M5 Pro delivers even more pro-level performance to breeze through demanding projects, from video production to game development. And this new level of performance takes on business workflows with ease whether Mac mini is being used as a primary desktop or for always-on, deskside agentic computing. Both Mac mini models include Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as upgraded 2.5Gb Ethernet, with a 10Gb option available. Combined with the power of macOS 27 and the next generation of Apple Intelligence, 3 including Siri AI, 4 the new Mac mini is a tremendous upgrade for existing and new-to-Mac users. The new Mac mini is available for pre-order starting today, with availability beginning September 22.

paragraphs.en: “Mac mini has always been our most versatile Mac. Whether it’s being used as a home computer, powering a professional studio, or as an always-on agentic device, it’s the little Mac that can do it all,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “Today, we’re taking this versatility even further. With a more powerful CPU and graphics, Neural Accelerators in the GPU, and higher memory bandwidth, Mac mini with M6 delivers a whole new level of AI performance. And with up to an 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU, Mac mini with M5 Pro is an ultracompact powerhouse for complex pro workflows. We can’t wait to see all the incredible ways people will use it next.”
paragraphs.zh: “Mac mini 一直以来都是我们最多功能的 Mac。 无论是用作家用电脑、为专业工作室提供动力，还是作为始终在线的智能体设备，它都能胜任一切任务，”Apple 首席硬件官 Johny Srouji 表示，“今天，我们将把这种多功能性进一步提升。 Mac mini 搭载 M6 芯片，拥有更强大的中央处理器和图形处理器、GPU 中的神经加速器和更高的内存带宽，带来了全新水平的 AI 性能。 而配备多达 18 核中央处理器和 20 核图形处理器的 Mac mini 搭载 M5 Pro 芯片，则是一款超紧凑的高性能设备，能够应对复杂的专业工作流程。 我们迫不及待地想看看人们接下来会用它创造出哪些令人惊叹的用途。”

paragraphs.en: Mac mini with M6 can power through everything from productivity tasks to creative projects, the latest AI workflows, and more. M6 features a 12-core CPU — two more cores than before — with the world’s fastest single-threaded performance, so everything feels extra snappy and responsive. A 12-core GPU, also with two more cores than before, now includes Neural Accelerators in each core for the first time on Mac mini, resulting in up to 4x faster AI performance and 2x faster graphics than Mac mini with M4. 1 In addition, the all-new Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 2x faster performance than the previous generation, and combined with the advanced GPU, Mac mini is a powerhouse for all things AI. 1 And with 16GB of standard unified memory configurable up to 32GB, as well as higher memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, multitasking is faster than ever.
paragraphs.zh: 搭载 M6 芯片的 Mac mini 能够轻松应对各种任务，从生产力工作到创意项目、最新的 AI 工作流程等。 M6 采用 12 核 CPU——比之前多两个核心——并拥有全球最快的单线程性能，让一切操作都格外流畅且响应迅速。 12 核 GPU 也比之前多两个核心，并且首次在 Mac mini 中为每个核心集成了神经加速器，使其 AI 性能最高可达 Mac mini（搭载 M4 芯片）的 4 倍，图形性能则快 2 倍。1 此外，全新的双 16 核神经网络引擎性能比上一代提升最多达 2 倍；结合先进的 GPU，Mac mini 成为处理各类 AI 任务的强大工具。1 同时，标配 16GB 统一内存（最高可扩展至 32GB），并支持高达 170GB/s 的更高内存带宽，让多任务处理比以往任何时候都更加迅速。

paragraphs.en: Mac mini with M5 Pro redefines what’s possible on such a small desktop, enabling pro users to take on demanding workflows like app development, video rendering, scientific simulations, and more. M5 Pro features up to an 18-core CPU with remarkable multithreaded performance and up to a 20-core GPU with an enhanced shader core and third-generation ray tracing for complex work in 3D design, VFX, and game development. With Neural Accelerators in each GPU core, M5 Pro also delivers significant gains in AI compute compared to the previous Mac mini, allowing users to tackle more advanced AI workflows like photo and video upscaling, and running large diffusion models faster than ever. Mac mini with M5 Pro supports up to 64GB of unified memory with 307GB/s of memory bandwidth, enabling users to run even larger local AI models, work with complex 3D scenes, edit ProRes RAW files, and load large custom datasets for research. And with industry-leading performance per watt, Mac mini with M5 Pro is quiet, efficient, and ideal as an always-on desktop for AI agents or creative workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 重新定义了如此小巧的台式机所能实现的功能，让专业用户能够处理应用程序开发、视频渲染、科学模拟等复杂任务。 M5 Pro 最高配备 18 核 CPU，具备出色的多线程性能，以及最高 20 核 GPU，其增强型着色器核心和第三代光线追踪技术可应对 3D 设计、视觉特效和游戏开发中的复杂工作。 每个 GPU 核心均内置神经加速器，M5 Pro 在 AI 计算能力方面也较上一代 Mac mini 实现了显著提升，让用户能够处理更高级的 AI 工作流程，例如照片和视频超分辨率处理，并以前所未有的速度运行大型扩散模型。 搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 支持最高 64GB 统一内存和高达 307GB/s 的内存带宽，使用户能够运行更大规模的本地 AI 模型、处理复杂的 3D 场景、编辑 ProRes RAW 文件，并为研究加载大型自定义数据集。 此外，凭借行业领先的每瓦性能，搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 运行安静、能效出色，是用作常开式台式机运行智能体或创意工作流程的理想选择。

sents.zh: 每个 GPU 核心均内置神经加速器，M5 Pro 在 AI 计算能力方面也较上一代 Mac mini 实现了显著提升，让用户能够处理更高级的 AI 工作流程，例如照片和视频超分辨率处理，并以前所未有的速度运行大型扩散模型。

sents.en: Mac mini with M5 Pro supports up to 64GB of unified memory with 307GB/s of memory bandwidth, enabling users to run even larger local AI models, work with complex 3D scenes, edit ProRes RAW files, and load large custom datasets for research.
sents.zh: 搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 支持最高 64GB 统一内存和高达 307GB/s 的内存带宽，使用户能够运行更大规模的本地 AI 模型、处理复杂的 3D 场景、编辑 ProRes RAW 文件，并为研究加载大型自定义数据集。

sents.en: And with industry-leading performance per watt, Mac mini with M5 Pro is quiet, efficient, and ideal as an always-on desktop for AI agents or creative workflows.
sents.zh: 此外，凭借行业领先的每瓦性能，搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 运行安静、能效出色，是用作常开式台式机运行智能体或创意工作流程的理想选择。

paragraphs.en: The new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro now supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as 2.5Gb Ethernet for faster wired connectivity, with 10Gb available. On its front are two USB-C ports that support USB 3 and a headphone jack with high-impedance headphone support for convenient access. On the back, there are three Thunderbolt 4 ports on Mac mini with M6, and three Thunderbolt 5 ports on Mac mini with M5 Pro, along with HDMI and Ethernet. Thunderbolt 5 also allows users to cluster multiple Mac mini systems together to run large AI models entirely on device. And newly added genlock support through USB-C enables precise synchronization between a display and camera, including iPhone 17 Pro.
paragraphs.zh: 搭载 M6 和 M5 Pro 的新款 Mac mini 现已支持 Wi-Fi 7 和蓝牙 6，并配备 2.5Gb 以太网以实现更快的有线连接，同时最高可达 10Gb。 正面设有两个支持 USB 3 的 USB-C 端口和一个支持高阻抗耳机的耳机插孔，方便用户使用。 背面方面，Mac mini（M6）配备三个 Thunderbolt 4 端口，而 Mac mini（M5 Pro）则配备三个 Thunderbolt 5 端口，此外还有 HDMI 和以太网接口。 Thunderbolt 5 还允许用户将多个 Mac mini 系统组合在一起，完全在设备本地运行大型 AI 模型。 新增的通过 USB-C 实现的帧同步支持，使得显示器与摄像头（包括 iPhone 17 Pro）之间能够实现精准同步。

paragraphs.en: macOS 27 Golden Gate: An Unrivaled Experience
paragraphs.zh: macOS 27 金门大桥：无与伦比的体验

paragraphs.en: The new Mac mini comes to life with the upcoming macOS 27, which includes Siri AI , a profoundly more capable and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across everyday apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help users find what they need in the moment across their messages, emails, and photos; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence using a dedicated keyboard shortcut. Users can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.
paragraphs.zh: 新款 Mac mini 将随着即将推出的 macOS 27 而焕发生机，该系统包含 Siri AI——一个能力更强大、更具个性化的助手；贯穿日常应用的实用 Apple Intelligence 功能；以及一系列广泛的改进，使 Mac 的响应速度和可靠性进一步提升。 Siri AI 可以利用个人上下文信息，帮助用户即时在消息、电子邮件和照片中查找所需内容；回答几乎任何主题的问题；并在各类应用中完成各种任务。 Siri AI 已集成到 Spotlight 和系统级上下文菜单中，用户还可以通过专用键盘快捷键使用视觉智能功能，向 Siri 询问屏幕上显示的内容。 用户几乎在任何输入文本的地方，都可以与 Siri 一起进行撰写和编辑。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful with new ways to tailor and organize browsing in Safari, easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, and tap into advanced photo editing in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass improve readability, and add uniform toolbars, edge-to-edge sidebars, and updated window shapes and menu bar icons, enabling users to further personalize its appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，Apple Intelligence 还能让应用程序变得更智能、更实用：它提供了在 Safari 中定制和整理浏览方式的新方法，只需简单描述即可在“快捷指令”中轻松创建自动化流程，并可在“照片”应用中实现高级照片编辑功能。 用户已经依赖的功能也通过性能和搜索方面的改进变得更加出色。 Liquid Glass 的优化提升了可读性，并增加了统一的工具栏、无边框侧边栏以及更新后的窗口形状和菜单栏图标，让用户能够进一步个性化其外观。

paragraphs.en: The new Mac mini was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 50 percent recycled material overall, 6 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets. All of the electricity used to manufacture Mac mini is sourced from renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain, and Apple has also invested in enough renewable energy around the world to match the electricity customers use to power Mac mini. Like all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based and can be easily recycled at home. 7
paragraphs.zh: 新款 Mac mini 的设计充分考虑了环境因素，推动了苹果宏伟计划的进展——即到 2030 年，在其整个业务足迹中实现碳中和。 该产品整体采用 50% 的回收材料制成，其中包括外壳中 100% 回收的铝以及所有磁铁中 100% 回收的稀土元素。 Mac mini 制造过程中使用的全部电力均来自供应链中的可再生能源（如风能和太阳能），此外，苹果还投资了全球范围内足以匹配客户使用 Mac mini 所消耗电力的可再生能源。 与所有苹果产品一样，其纸质包装完全由纤维制成，并且可以在家中轻松回收。
